posts.name: William Kolar
posts.cooked: In my opinion, this game is… Fine. The heroes are fun. The villains are challenging. The environments are creative. But there’s something… Missing. Maybe it’s the Great Value justice league. Maybe the card art. Maybe the variants (Captain Thunder with a mask, a male version of a female version of Batman, and the hideous art on One with Freedom Dr. Metropolis all come to mind). But no. I think it’s the presentation. The graphic design? Boring. The music? Cliche ( Except for Argo’s theme, which is great). But most of all: This is a super hero universe, and not a comic book one. Will I buy future expansions? Of course. But I hope that these problems get fixed in the near future.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: The art is sourced by people contracted by Green Ronin and the mechanics were done by GTG. Since it’s not an IP Christopher controls he was given stuff to go off but not his own lore to go off. Additionally no idea of what final art might be like which he usually got with Adam. Lastly, the mechanics were done right after OblivAeon was finished and Christopher has mentioned his head wasn’t quite in the right place. However, it needed done as OblivAeon had delayed his work on it.
